brief:
Médecins Sans Frontières condemned an Israeli strike that killed two of its staff members working as watchmen outside a medical clinic in Gaza on Friday evening, according to Al-Monitor. The charity expressed outrage over the incident, which struck the facility in the territory's south.

The two workers were positioned outside the clinic when the strike occurred. MSF did not immediately specify whether the facility itself was targeted or provide additional details about the circumstances of the attack.
dek: By Emma Farge and Nidal al-Mughrabi GENEVA/CAIRO, Nov 28 (Reuters) - Medical charity Médecins Sans Frontièreshas voiced outrage after an Israeli strike killed two of its staff working as watchmen outside a medical clinic in Gaza late on Friday.
title: Israeli strike kills two MSF staff outside Gaza clinic
